annotations.title: Find the best ski resorts for a traveler

description: Ranks ski resorts for one traveler or group: terrain that fits their ability (beginner/intermediate/advanced/expert, or a mixed group), snow and crowds for their dates, travel from their home airport or city (drive or fly), and their Epic/Ikon pass. Returns the reasons for each pick plus lodging, flight and rental links. Use for 'where should I ski' questions.

ability.description: Ability of each skier or the group, e.g. ['intermediate'] or ['advanced','beginner'].

area.description: Limit to a country, state or range, e.g. 'colorado', 'utah', 'alps', 'japan', 'US'.

budget.description: Value weights pass coverage and driving more heavily.

from.description: Traveler's home airport code (e.g. DFW), city (e.g. 'Dallas') or 'lat,lon'.

travel.description: How they want to get there (default either).

name: find_ski_resorts
title: Find the best ski resorts for a traveler
